arguments.reason: I can't build a rule from the fraud outcomes. Rules may not read the fraud labels, because the labels are what the rule is scored against. A rule also can't be guaranteed 100% precision and 100% recall on this data. I can instead help you find a pattern in transaction attributes, such as amount, channel, merchant category, card type or velocity, and propose it as a rule. The application will then report its precision and recall against the labels.
